December 2025
A room of strangers, an introduction to iGEM, and no project. Everyone went away to write a pitch of their own.
blocks.text: A room of strangers, an introduction to iGEM, and no project. Everyone went away to write a pitch of their own.
blocks.zh: 一屋子的陌生人、一場 iGEM 的介紹，還沒有專題。每個人各自回去寫自己的提案。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2025-12-13">Dec 13</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2025-12-13">12 月 13 日</time>

blocks.en: The first meeting. Nobody knew anybody yet.
blocks.text: The first meeting. Nobody knew anybody yet.
blocks.zh: 第一次聚會。那時誰也不認識誰。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2025-12-27">Dec 27</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2025-12-27">12 月 27 日</time>

blocks.en: Pitching our own project ideas to the advisors.
blocks.text: Pitching our own project ideas to the advisors.
blocks.zh: 向顧問提案我們自己的專題構想。

blocks.en: January and February 2026
blocks.zh: 2026 年 1 月與 2 月

blocks.en: Five candidate projects went down to two, then to one: protecting plants from stress. The first roadmap split the work into four tracks, all pointing at a field test.
blocks.text: Five candidate projects went down to two, then to one: protecting plants from stress. The first roadmap split the work into four tracks, all pointing at a field test.
blocks.zh: 五個候選專題收斂到兩個，再收斂到一個：保護植物度過逆境。第一版路線圖把工作分成四條線，全都指向田間測試。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-02-01">Feb 1</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-02-01">2 月 1 日</time>

blocks.en: Our first outreach meeting, with Ubuntu Social Enterprise, held online.
blocks.text: Our first outreach meeting, with Ubuntu Social Enterprise, held online.
blocks.zh: 我們第一次對外會談，對象是 Ubuntu Social Enterprise，線上進行。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-02-05">Feb 5</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-02-05">2 月 5 日</time>

blocks.en: The first roadmap: four tracks, and a field test at the end of all of them.
blocks.text: The first roadmap: four tracks, and a field test at the end of all of them.
blocks.zh: 第一版路線圖：四條工作線，盡頭是一次田間測試。

blocks.en: March 2026
Everyone sat through lab safety training. Then we went to Professor Cheng Mei-Chun’s lab at NTU and came home with Arabidopsis seeds.
blocks.text: Everyone sat through lab safety training. Then we went to Professor Cheng Mei-Chun’s lab at NTU and came home with Arabidopsis seeds.
blocks.zh: 所有人都上完實驗室安全訓練。接著我們去了臺大鄭美君教授的實驗室，帶著阿拉伯芥種子回來。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-03-07">Mar 7</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-03-07">3 月 7 日</time>

blocks.en: Lab safety class, before anyone was allowed to touch anything.
blocks.text: Lab safety class, before anyone was allowed to touch anything.
blocks.zh: 實驗室安全課，上完才准碰任何東西。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-03-27">Mar 27</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-03-27">3 月 27 日</time>

blocks.en: At Professor Cheng’s lab at NTU, learning the plant protocols and taking seeds home.
blocks.text: At Professor Cheng’s lab at NTU, learning the plant protocols and taking seeds home.
blocks.zh: 在臺大鄭教授的實驗室學植物操作流程，並把種子帶回家。

blocks.en: April 2026

April changed the project. After talking to Dr. Verslues and Professor Chen Wen-Liang we dropped the earlier design for a light-controlled bioreactor, with a hollow-fiber membrane keeping the bacteria in and letting the protectant out.
blocks.text: April changed the project. After talking to Dr. Verslues and Professor Chen Wen-Liang we dropped the earlier design for a light-controlled bioreactor, with a hollow-fiber membrane keeping the bacteria in and letting the protectant out.
blocks.zh: 四月改變了這個專題。與 Dr. Verslues 和陳文亮教授談過之後，我們放棄先前的設計，改做一台光控生物反應器——以中空纖維膜把細菌留在裡面，讓保護劑出來。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-04-03">Apr 3</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-04-03">4 月 3 日</time>

blocks.en: Visiting Dr. Paul Verslues at Academia Sinica.
blocks.text: Visiting Dr. Paul Verslues at Academia Sinica.
blocks.zh: 到中央研究院拜訪 Dr. Paul Verslues。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-04-12">Apr 12</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-04-12">4 月 12 日</time>

blocks.en: Professor Chen Wen-Liang online, on hardware and on the business case. The first bioreactor sketches came out of that call.
blocks.text: Professor Chen Wen-Liang online, on hardware and on the business case. The first bioreactor sketches came out of that call.
blocks.zh: 陳文亮教授線上談硬體與商業面。第一批生物反應器草圖就是從那通電話來的。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-04-25">Apr 25</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-04-25">4 月 25 日</time>

blocks.en: Working out what the hollow-fiber cartridge would have to look like.
blocks.text: Working out what the hollow-fiber cartridge would have to look like.
blocks.zh: 推敲中空纖維匣應該長什麼樣子。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-04-26">Apr 26</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-04-26">4 月 26 日</time>

blocks.en: An advisor explaining Arabidopsis to the rest of us.
blocks.text: An advisor explaining Arabidopsis to the rest of us.
blocks.zh: 一位顧問向其他人講解阿拉伯芥。

blocks.en: May 2026

We grew Arabidopsis on agar, in hydroponics and in soil to see which we could run stress assays on. The hardware team started breadboarding a photometer and a light plate because we could not buy either.
blocks.text: We grew Arabidopsis on agar, in hydroponics and in soil to see which we could run stress assays on. The hardware team started breadboarding a photometer and a light plate because we could not buy either.
blocks.zh: 我們把阿拉伯芥種在瓊脂、水耕與土壤裡，看哪一種可以拿來做逆境檢測。硬體組開始在麵包板上做光度計與光照板，因為這兩樣我們都買不到。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-05-09">May 9</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-05-09">5 月 9 日</time>

blocks.en: A hydroponics box in parts, and the first seedlings going into soil.
blocks.text: A hydroponics box in parts, and the first seedlings going into soil.
blocks.zh: 拆開的水耕槽，以及第一批下土的幼苗。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-05-14">May 14</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-05-14">5 月 14 日</time>

blocks.en: All three methods in one incubator: agar plates, hydroponic boxes and pots.
blocks.text: All three methods in one incubator: agar plates, hydroponic boxes and pots.
blocks.zh: 三種方法同時放進一台培養箱：瓊脂盤、水耕槽與盆栽。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-05-16">May 16</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-05-16">5 月 16 日</time>

blocks.en: Our first farmers’ expo, asking growers what stress actually costs them.
blocks.text: Our first farmers’ expo, asking growers what stress actually costs them.
blocks.zh: 我們第一次參加農民市集，問農友逆境實際上讓他們付出多少代價。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-05-22">May 22</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-05-22">5 月 22 日</time>

blocks.en: The World Vegetable Center, on who our product is really for.
blocks.text: The World Vegetable Center, on who our product is really for.
blocks.zh: 世界蔬菜中心，談我們的產品究竟是為誰而做。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-05-27">May 27</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-05-27">5 月 27 日</time>

blocks.en: Sketching a spectrophotometer we could build ourselves.
blocks.text: Sketching a spectrophotometer we could build ourselves.
blocks.zh: 畫出一台我們自己做得出來的分光光度計。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-05-30">May 30</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-05-30">5 月 30 日</time>

blocks.en: Testing the school activities on ourselves first.
blocks.text: Testing the school activities on ourselves first.
blocks.zh: 先拿自己試跑學校活動。

blocks.en: June 2026

The first growth test in the hollow-fiber loop worked: the culture stayed where it was meant to. Plenty else did not. Professor Chang and Professor Chen came to pick the design apart, and we ran our first workshops in three primary schools.
blocks.text: The first growth test in the hollow-fiber loop worked: the culture stayed where it was meant to. Plenty else did not. Professor Chang and Professor Chen came to pick the design apart, and we ran our first workshops in three primary schools.
blocks.zh: 中空纖維迴路的第一次生長測試成功了：菌液留在該留的地方。其他很多事則不然。張教授與陳教授來把設計拆開來檢視，我們也在三所國小辦了第一批工作坊。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-06-10">Jun 10</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-06-10">6 月 10 日</time>

blocks.en: The first Bacillus subtilis growth test in the hollow-fiber loop, with flask cultures alongside it.
blocks.text: The first Bacillus subtilis growth test in the hollow-fiber loop, with flask cultures alongside it.
blocks.zh: 中空纖維迴路中第一次枯草桿菌生長測試，旁邊同時跑著燒瓶培養。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-06-17">Jun 17</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-06-17">6 月 17 日</time>

blocks.en: Not every week is a good week: seedling plates set up the wrong way round, and a contaminated run.
blocks.text: Not every week is a good week: seedling plates set up the wrong way round, and a contaminated run.
blocks.zh: 不是每一週都是好週：幼苗盤方向擺反了，還有一次培養被污染。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-06-18">Jun 18</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-06-18">6 月 18 日</time>

blocks.en: Professor Chang Jo-Shu on the bioreactor, and on our B. subtilis problems.
blocks.text: Professor Chang Jo-Shu on the bioreactor, and on our B. subtilis problems.
blocks.zh: 張嘉修教授談生物反應器，也談我們在枯草桿菌上遇到的問題。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-06-19">Jun 19</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-06-19">6 月 19 日</time>

blocks.en: The whole system on one board for the first time: reactor, bug, construct, secretion, membrane, soil, plant.
blocks.text: The whole system on one board for the first time: reactor, bug, construct, secretion, membrane, soil, plant.
blocks.zh: 整套系統第一次畫在同一塊板子上：反應器、菌、構築、分泌、膜、土壤、植物。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-06-20">Jun 20</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-06-20">6 月 20 日</time>

blocks.en: Professor Chen Wen-Liang went through the lot: model, plants, protectant, hydroponics, circuit, reactor.
blocks.text: Professor Chen Wen-Liang went through the lot: model, plants, protectant, hydroponics, circuit, reactor.
blocks.zh: 陳文亮教授把全部過了一遍：模型、植物、保護劑、水耕、迴路、反應器。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-06-24">Jun 24</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-06-24">6 月 24 日</time>

blocks.en: Our first education events, at three primary schools.
blocks.text: Our first education events, at three primary schools.
blocks.zh: 我們第一批教育活動，在三所國小。

blocks.en: July 2026

The light plate went together, the pressure sensor started reporting, and the inline photometer read a live culture in the loop, about four times too high. That reading gave August its job. Outside the lab we spent a day on Ms. Chen’s farm and a day at BIO Asia.
blocks.text: The light plate went together, the pressure sensor started reporting, and the inline photometer read a live culture in the loop, about four times too high. That reading gave August its job. Outside the lab we spent a day on Ms. Chen’s farm and a day at BIO Asia.
blocks.zh: 光照板組裝完成，壓力感測器開始回報讀值，線上光度計也在迴路中讀到了活菌液——只是高了大約四倍。那個讀值決定了八月要做什麼。實驗室之外，我們在陳女士的農場待了一天，也去了一天 BIO Asia。

blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-07-02">7 月 2 日</time>

blocks.en: Our first junior high school event.
blocks.text: Our first junior high school event.
blocks.zh: 我們第一場國中活動。

blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-07-07">7 月 7 日</time>

blocks.text: Dr. Daniel Viragh of the Berkeley Historical GIS Project, and a way to map Taiwan’s farmland.
blocks.zh: Berkeley Historical GIS Project 的 Dr. Daniel Viragh，以及一套描繪臺灣農地的方法。

blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-07-09">7 月 9 日</time>

blocks.zh: 到詮興生技，再帶著他們的一款保護劑回實驗室當對照。接著是一整晚按亮度把 LED 分類。

blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-07-12">7 月 12 日</time>

blocks.text: The pressure sensor sending live readings to a laptop for the first time.

blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-07-17">7 月 17 日</time>

blocks.en: The light plate apparatus, assembled, every LED matched.

blocks.zh: 我們的光度計在迴路中讀到了活菌液。對照 BioDrop，它高了四倍。

blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-07-21">7 月 21 日</time>

blocks.text: A day on Ms. Chen Hui-Wen’s natural farm. Yes, we picked cucumbers.
blocks.zh: 在陳惠文女士的自然農場待了一天。是的，我們去摘了小黃瓜。

blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-07-28">7 月 28 日</time>

blocks.text: Professor Huang Chieh-Chen online, on when and how much protectant to deliver.
blocks.zh: 黃介辰教授線上談何時施用保護劑、該施多少。

blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-07-29">7 月 29 日</time>

blocks.en: August 2026

pH and dissolved-oxygen sensors joined the loop, the photometer was calibrated into agreement with a real instrument, and the whole rig moved into an old computer case. We also came back from NCHU with WB800, the strain the rest of the year ran on.
blocks.text: pH and dissolved-oxygen sensors joined the loop, the photometer was calibrated into agreement with a real instrument, and the whole rig moved into an old computer case. We also came back from NCHU with WB800, the strain the rest of the year ran on.
blocks.zh: pH 與溶氧感測器加進迴路，光度計校正到與真正的儀器一致，整組裝置也搬進一台舊電腦機殼裡。我們還從中興大學帶回 WB800——這一年後半所有實驗都跑在這株菌上。

blocks.en: <time datetime="2026-08-03">Aug 3</time>
blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-08-03">8 月 3 日</time>

blocks.en: Reactor, photometer and plants in one incubator overnight, logged by our own instrument.
blocks.text: Reactor, photometer and plants in one incubator overnight, logged by our own instrument.
blocks.zh: 反應器、光度計與植物整夜放在同一台培養箱裡，由我們自己的儀器記錄。

blocks.zh: <time datetime="2026-08-04">8 月 4 日</time>

blocks.zh: 在公園拍攝宣傳影片。

blocks.text: Calibrating the photometer against the BioDrop, and moving the whole rig into an empty computer case.

blocks.text: We ran our own public forum at the Taipei Water Garden market and put the project in front of farmers and strangers. In the lab a 10 kb plasmid finally went into WB800, and the light plate ran its first assay.

attrs.en: A schematic: stress induces a light sensor to switch on or off for heat, salinity and drought; green and red light arrows lead to three labelled chambers of engineered Bacillus subtilis; an arrow marked different protectants released in response to different stresses passes through a selective membrane into a block of soil.

attrs.zh: 方格紙上的手寫筆記，標題為「保護劑的存在使逆境漸增時的生長提升」，附一張預測植物生物量對逆境指數的圖（對照組與處理組），以及第二張比較未處理、事後處理與預報觸發處理的生物量對時間圖。

attrs.en: A student in a lab coat and gloves running a photometer calibration at a bench with a laptop and the sensor rig, while an instructor in a lab coat sits alongside watching.
attrs.zh: 一位穿實驗衣、戴手套的學生在檯面上以筆電與感測裝置進行光度計校正，一位穿實驗衣的指導老師坐在一旁觀看。

attrs.en: A student standing at a table using a screwdriver on the frame of an empty black computer tower case, with another student watching from the right.
attrs.zh: 一位學生站在桌邊，用螺絲起子處理一台空的黑色電腦直立機殼框架，另一位學生在右側觀看。

attrs.en: Students looking into a plant growth chamber.
attrs.zh: 學生往植物生長箱裡看。

attrs.en: A clear hydroponic box with a white floating seed-holder rack.
attrs.zh: 透明的水耕槽，上面是白色的浮動種子座架。

attrs.en: Two students fitting the bioreactor into a black computer case.
attrs.zh: 兩位學生把生物反應器裝進黑色電腦機殼裡。

attrs.en: A student assembling a stress map of Taiwan on a table.
attrs.zh: 一位學生在桌上拼組臺灣的逆境地圖。

attrs.en: Two students pointing at the ReLEAF poster.
attrs.zh: 兩位學生指著 ReLEAF 海報。

attrs.en: A team member rehearsing in front of a wall screen showing a slide headed 我們的產品, our products, with phone interface mockups, while a seated listener takes notes.
attrs.zh: 一位團隊成員對著牆面螢幕彩排，螢幕上的投影片標題為「我們的產品」，並有手機介面的示意圖；一位坐著的聽眾正在記筆記。

attrs.en: Professor Chang Jo-Shu’s second visit to GEMS, where we updated him on our current progress and the challenges we were facing.
attrs.zh: 張嘉修教授第二次到 GEMS，我們向他報告目前進度與遇到的挑戰。

attrs.en: Team members on stage during the forum.
attrs.zh: 論壇中團隊成員站在台上。

attrs.en: A student explaining the bioreactor poster to a visitor.
attrs.zh: 一位學生向參觀者講解生物反應器海報。

attrs.en: Public Forum event: Data physicalization booth.
attrs.zh: 公開論壇活動：數據實體化攤位。

attrs.en: The team posed together at the market.
attrs.zh: 團隊在市集合影。

attrs.en: Two team members at an exhibition stand with an exhibitor.
attrs.zh: 兩位團隊成員與一位參展者在展覽攤位前。

attrs.en: Attending the NCHU Symposium where we received feedback such as developing a deeper understanding of our experimental data and the ACCD mechanism.
attrs.zh: 參加中興大學研討會，獲得的回饋包括要更深入理解自己的實驗數據與 ACCD 的作用機制。

attrs.en: Attending the NCHU Symposium where we received feedback such as developing a deeper understanding of our experimental data and the ACCD mechanism.
attrs.zh: 參加中興大學研討會，獲得的回饋包括要更深入理解自己的實驗數據與 ACCD 的作用機制。

attrs.en: Meeting with Dr. Sattely and Prof. Endy, focusing on how we present our experimental design, controls, mechanism, and the role of ACCD in our system.
attrs.zh: 與 Dr. Sattely 和 Prof. Endy 會面，聚焦在我們如何呈現實驗設計、對照組、機制，以及 ACCD 在系統中的角色。

attrs.en: A video call with Ms. Chen and team members, a slide about a LINE service for farmers on screen.
attrs.zh: 與陳女士及團隊成員的視訊通話，螢幕上是一張關於農友 LINE 服務的投影片。

attrs.en: Successfully electroporated a level 2 10k+ bp plasmid into B. subtilis WB800 for the first time, allowing us to move forward to LPA testing.
attrs.zh: 首次成功把一個 10k bp 以上的 Level 2 質體電穿孔進 B. subtilis WB800，讓我們得以往下進行 LPA 測試。

attrs.en: Successfully electroporated a level 2 10k+ bp plasmid into B. subtilis WB800 for the first time, allowing us to move forward to LPA testing.
attrs.zh: 首次成功把一個 10k bp 以上的 Level 2 質體電穿孔進 B. subtilis WB800，讓我們得以往下進行 LPA 測試。

attrs.en: The first light-control assay on the light plate apparatus, run by the Wet Lab.
attrs.zh: 光照板裝置上的第一次光控檢測，由濕實驗組執行。

attrs.en: Tubes glowing green in the light plate apparatus inside an incubator.
attrs.zh: 培養箱內光照板裝置中的培養管發出綠光。

attrs.en: Our first mock judging session as a whole team, including splitting up into groups and learning more about the details of the judging session.
attrs.zh: 全隊第一次模擬評審，包括分組進行，以及更了解評審環節的細節。

attrs.en: Our first mock judging session as a whole team, including splitting up into groups and learning more about the details of the judging session.
attrs.zh: 全隊第一次模擬評審，包括分組進行，以及更了解評審環節的細節。

attrs.en: Double photometer calibration test using SiO2.
attrs.zh: 以 SiO2 進行兩台光度計的校正測試。

attrs.en: Testing the air sensor and leaf sensor near the elevator, where temperature and humidity are less stable.
attrs.zh: 在電梯附近測試空氣感測器與葉片感測器，該處的溫度與濕度較不穩定。

attrs.en: Consultation with Director Wu Tsz-Hsien from the Miaoli District Agricultural Research and Extension Station to validate our field application and farmer outreach channels.
attrs.zh: 與苗栗區農業改良場吳姿賢場長諮詢，以驗證我們的田間應用與觸及農友的管道。

attrs.en: Meeting with Lu An-Bang, founder of Agriweather, an agricultural tech company specializing in smart weather monitoring and microclimate data systems.
attrs.zh: 與 Agriweather 創辦人呂安邦會面；該農業科技公司專長於智慧氣象監測與微氣候數據系統。

attrs.en: A student in a lab coat crouched at the open bioreactor cabinet at night, taking a sample from the loop.
attrs.zh: 一位穿實驗衣的學生深夜蹲在打開的生物反應器櫃前，自迴路取樣。

attrs.en: A laptop on a bench showing the dashboard: a growth curve climbing on a dark blue panel beside live pressure and pH readings.
attrs.zh: 實驗檯上的筆電顯示儀表板：深藍面板上一條往上爬的生長曲線，旁邊是即時的壓力與 pH 讀值。

attrs.en: The work room full of students standing and sitting at every desk, the nearest table covered in parts, cables and food.
attrs.zh: 工作室裡擠滿學生，每張桌子邊都有人站著或坐著，最近的一張桌上堆滿零件、線材與食物。

attrs.en: The whole team and the instructors lined up behind a long wooden table at GEMS.
attrs.zh: 全隊與指導老師在 GEMS 一張長木桌後排成一列。

attrs.en: A student standing at the screen talking to the rest of the team, everyone turned towards the front of the room.
attrs.zh: 一位學生站在螢幕前對其他隊員說話，所有人都轉向房間前方。

attrs.en: Five students in GEMS Taiwan T-shirts standing with Mr. Airy Quillere in front of the Bureau Français de Taipei sign, holding a gift box between them.
attrs.zh: 五位穿著 GEMS Taiwan T 恤的學生與 Airy Quillere 先生站在法國在台協會招牌前，中間捧著一個禮盒。
